tools.name: inspect_target
tools.description: Inspects BUILD.gn and BUILD.bazel in the target directory

tools.name: find_rdeps
tools.description: Finds true reverse dependencies across BUILD.gn and BUILD.bazel (excluding visibility allowlists and GN-only sentinel targets) and computes per-target 3-tier visibility recommendations (tight :__pkg__/LCA for narrow targets, 2-3 level area rollups for medium targets, and //visibility:public for globally-used platform libraries across >=6 areas)
